acceptanceCriteria: The RSpec and Jest/Vitest live providers can record, per example, which declared stubs/mocks were invoked (count), bound to the committed blob digest.
STUB-NEVER-INVOKED gains a run-based form from that receipt; without a receipt it stays the static advisory form.
body: Residual from V1-1887 (PR #1184, TSA-V0-125 residual). STUB-NEVER-INVOKED ships static-only because no provider receipt records stub invocations.
title: Run-based STUB-NEVER-INVOKED: call-recording receipts for RSpec and Jest/Vitest stubs
